import java.io.*;

public class cf111cVariants {
    public static int N, M, maxMask;
    public static int[][][] dp;
    public static int[] popcount;

    public static int countBits(int x) {
        int cnt = 0;
        while (x > 0) {
            cnt++;
            x &= (x - 1);
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    public static boolean valid(int a, int b, int c) {
        int res = (maxMask - 1) & (b | (b << 1) | (b >> 1) | a | c);
        return res == (maxMask - 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);

        if (n < m) {
            int tmp = m;
            m = n;
            n = tmp;
        }

        N = n;
        M = m;
        maxMask = 1 << m;
        dp = new int[n + 1][maxMask][maxMask];
        popcount = new int[maxMask];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < maxMask; j++) {
                Arrays.fill(dp[i][j], 100);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < maxMask; i++) {
            popcount[i] = countBits(i);
            dp[0][0][i] = 0;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < maxMask; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < maxMask; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < maxMask; l++) {
                        if (dp[i - 1][k][l] != 100 && valid(k, l, j)) {
                            int val = dp[i - 1][k][l] + popcount[l];
                            if (val < dp[i][l][j]) dp[i][l][j] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = 100;
        for (int i = 0; i < maxMask; i++) {
            if (dp[n][i][0] < ans) ans = dp[n][i][0];
        }

        System.out.println(n * m - ans);
    }
}

public class cf111cVariants2 {
    public static int n, m, maxm;
    public static int[][][] dp;
    public static int[] s;

    public static int popc(int x) {
        return (int) Integer.toBinaryString(x).chars().filter(c -> c == '1').count();
    }

    public static boolean check(int a, int b, int c) {
        int res = (maxm - 1) & (b | (b << 1) | (b >> 1) | a | c);
        return res == maxm - 1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] argv) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();
        if (n < m) {
            int t = m;
            m = n;
            n = t;
        }
        maxm = 1 << m;
        dp = new int[n + 1][maxm][maxm];
        s = new int[maxm];

        IntStream.range(0, n + 1).forEach(i -> IntStream.range(0, maxm).forEach(j -> Arrays.fill(dp[i][j], 100)));
        IntStream.range(0, maxm).forEach(i -> {
            s[i] = popc(i);
            dp[0][0][i] = 0;
        });

        IntStream.rangeClosed(1, n).forEach(i ->
            IntStream.range(0, maxm).forEach(j ->
                IntStream.range(0, maxm).forEach(k ->
                    IntStream.range(0, maxm).forEach(l -> {
                        if (dp[i - 1][k][l] != 100 && check(k, l, j)) {
                            int newVal = dp[i - 1][k][l] + s[l];
                            if (newVal < dp[i][l][j]) dp[i][l][j] = newVal;
                        }
                    })
                )
            )
        );

        int ans = IntStream.range(0, maxm).map(i -> dp[n][i][0]).min().orElse(100);
        System.out.println(n * m - ans);
    }
}

    public static int[][][] memo;
    public static int[] popc;

    public static int countBits(int val) {
        int cnt = 0;
        while (val > 0) {
            cnt += val & 1;
            val >>>= 1;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    public static boolean isCompatible(int upper, int current, int lower) {
        int merged = (maxState - 1) & (current | (current << 1) | (current >>> 1) | upper | lower);
        return merged == (maxState - 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int r = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        if (r < c) {
            int tmp = r;
            r = c;
            c = tmp;
        }
        rows = r;
        cols = c;
        maxState = 1 << c;
        memo = new int[rows + 1][maxState][maxState];
        popc = new int[maxState];

        for (int i = 0; i <= rows; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < maxState; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < maxState; k++) {
                    memo[i][j][k] = 100;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < maxState; i++) {
            popc[i] = countBits(i);
            memo[0][0][i] = 0;
        }

        for (int layer = 1; layer <= rows; layer++) {
            for (int cur = 0; cur < maxState; cur++) {
                for (int prevPrev = 0; prevPrev < maxState; prevPrev++) {
                    for (int prev = 0; prev < maxState; prev++) {
                        if (memo[layer - 1][prevPrev][prev] != 100 && isCompatible(prevPrev, prev, cur)) {
                            int candidate = memo[layer - 1][prevPrev][prev] + popc[prev];
                            if (candidate < memo[layer][prev][cur]) {

                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int best = 100;
        for (int i = 0; i < maxState; i++) {
            best = Math.min(best, memo[rows][i][0]);
        }
        System.out.println(rows * cols - best);
    }
}

    }

        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));

                Arrays.fill(dp[i][j], 1000);

        for (int i = 0; i < maxMask; i++) {
            bitCount[i] = popc(i);
            dp[0][0][i] = 0;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < maxMask; k++) {

import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class cf111cVariants5 {
    public static int R, C, states;
    public static int[][][] f;
    public static int[] cnt;

    public static int bitCount(int x) {
        int c = 0;
        for (c = 0; x != 0; c++) x &= x - 1;
        return c;
    }

    public static boolean can(int up, int mid, int down) {
        int bits = (states - 1) & (mid | (mid << 1) | (mid >> 1) | up | down);
        return bits == (states - 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        R = sc.nextInt();
        C = sc.nextInt();
        if (R < C) {
            int tmp = R;
            R = C;
            C = tmp;
        }
        states = 1 << C;
        f = new int[R + 1][states][states];
        cnt = new int[states];

        for (int i = 0; i < R + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < states; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < states; k++) {
                    f[i][j][k] = 100;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < states; i++) {
            cnt[i] = bitCount(i);
            f[0][0][i] = 0;
        }

        for (int row = 1; row <= R; row++) {
            // iterate over possible configurations of row-2 and row-1
            for (int a = 0; a < states; a++) {
                for (int b = 0; b < states; b++) {
                    if (f[row - 1][a][b] == 100) continue;
                    for (int c = 0; c < states; c++) {
                        if (can(a, b, c)) {
                            int val = f[row - 1][a][b] + cnt[b];
                            if (val < f[row][b][c]) f[row][b][c] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = 100;
        for (int i = 0; i < states; i++) ans = Math.min(ans, f[R][i][0]);
        System.out.println(R * C - ans);
    }
}
